description: Pause one lead of a campaign: nothing more goes to it from this campaign until `until`, or until release_campaign_lead when `until` is null or left out. An email already made for it that hasn't started to go out is canceled (`lead_held`), and its step goes after the pause. Pausing a paused lead again keeps when the pause started and replaces its end; the same end again changes nothing. A date that has passed answers 400 `leadHoldEndPassed`. This pause is apart from an away message's hold (`heldUntil`): neither ends the other, and a step waits for whichever ends later. The pause doesn't add to a step's wait: the step is due once both are over. It changes nothing the campaign sends, so it needs no `send` and keeps the approval.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

until.description: When the pause ends, as an ISO 8601 date and time with its offset; it must be ahead of now. null or left out: no end date, until release_campaign_lead. Pausing a paused lead again replaces the end.

name: hold_campaign_lead
title: Pause a lead
